draft.subject: Re: Inviting a teammate
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Following up on your questions. As Tariq noted, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. On your other open note: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap -- I'll keep you posted there.

If it's helpful, I'm glad to hop on a short call this week to get your first teammates added and your project set up the way your team works.

Best,
Nadia
